keyVerseDR: "Come to me all you that labor and are burdened, and I will refresh you." (Mt 11:28)

level1.title: Come Rest With Jesus
level1.story: Jesus thanked God His Father. He said, "Come to Me when you are tired." Jesus gives us rest.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: When do you need Jesus' help?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I come to You for rest. Amen.

activity.title: Time to rest with Jesus
activity.intro: Draw the time on the clock when you will pray quietly.

level2.title: My Yoke Is Easy
level2.story: Jesus prayed, "I give praise to You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth." He thanked the Father for showing these things to little ones. Jesus said, "Come to Me, all you who are tired and burdened, and I will give you rest." He said, "Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am meek and humble of heart." Jesus said, "My yoke is easy, and My burden light."
level2.keyLine: Come to me all you that labor, and I will refresh you.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does God show things to the 'little ones'?
level2.prayer: Jesus, meek and humble of heart, make my heart like Yours. Amen.

activity.title: Dear Jesus
activity.intro: Jesus says, "Come to Me." Write Him a short letter.

art.mainBrief: Jesus inviting tired people to rest; lamb on shoulders
